question: By what agency and to what extent does the yoginī named Will operate?
premises: Her operation extends up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī named Will, through the siddhas and supreme will, operates up to the limit of māyā.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of siddhaiḥ and māyāntaṃ is compressed and open to interpretation.
plain_english: The yoginī named Will, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to māyā.
